headline: Thursday night, SEA @ DEN: two small Seattle props clear the bar, 1.5u total. The game lines are tight to Pinnacle.

games.note: Two props; spread and total within the bar. Weather mild: 52F, wind about 7 mph, no rain at kickoff.

picks.subject: George Holani
picks.label: George Holani under 4.5 rush att
picks.reason: Pinnacle exact number (-139 fair) vs DK -126; Holani is the clear RB2 behind Emanuel Wilson (8 touches to Wilson's 22 last week with Charbonnet already out), so his role is the same and the under holds.

picks.subject: Rashid Shaheed
picks.label: Rashid Shaheed over 20.5 rec yds
picks.reason: Pinnacle's 22.5 adjusted to DK's 20.5 gives -127 fair vs -114; Shaheed is healthy, averages about 21 yds a game in Seattle, and Denver is without CB Pat Surtain. Half unit because it sits just over the adjusted-line bar.

passed.label: George Holani under 14.5 rush yds (+4.8%)
passed.why: Pinnacle and consensus disagree by more than 4 pts, which raises the bar to 5.0%; one Holani prop is enough anyway.

notes: Single-game day, so no parlays (legs must come from different games).
